scope: Model-guided artwork curation of a new Park lookalike, not independent accuracy or held-out evaluation
scan: All4096 RGB-only windows on the fixed64x64lattice; frozen QNN and threshold
selectionPreference: Natural-looking placement with local learned score0.4..0.8, greater than original Chromium background max0.37455, and no accepted decoy at frozen threshold
phaseFollowup: May inspect +/-2px phases around at most two promising placements; retain all outcomes
finalRenderer: composeCuratedScene over canonical native-high staged Park512canvas; no pixel editing
forbidden: No fitting, feature edits, source PNG edits, threshold adjustment, reserve-test claims, or placement metadata as inference inputs
backendLimit: Native canvas and Chromium filtering differ; root must inspect actual browser final composite before integration
